ingredientSections.heading: Goat Curry
items: ¾ Cup colombo or madras curry powder

methodSections.heading: Goat Curry
steps: Squeeze the lime juice all over the goat and let sit for at least 10 minutes. Then season the goat with half of the black pepper and coriander.
Finely dice the onion, garlic and ginger. Using kitchen twine, tie the thyme and bay leaves into a small bouquet garni so it's easy to remove when cooked.
In a large pot over a medium high heat, sweat the onions and then add the ginger and garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the curry powder, coriander and bouquet garni, mix together and toast for 1 minute.
Add the goat meat and mix well, reduce heat to medium low and cook for 5 minutes until the meat is evenly brown and juices form in the pot. Be careful not to burn the curry powder.
Add the stock and simmer with the lid on for 1½-2 hours or until meat is tender stirring occasionally. Remove and discard the bouquet garni.
Serve with rice and beans and a leafy salad.

methodSections.heading: Rice & Beans
steps: Finely dice the onion and then sweat in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the garlic and cajun spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add all the remaining ingredients, cover, bring to a boil and then reduce to a simmer. Cook, stirring occasionally until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is soft and fluffy.
